sentences.en: You can't get a tree to grow on bad soil.
sentences.zh: 在贫瘠的土地上栽树是长不起来的。

sentences.en: Agriculture is defined as the cultivation of soil for growing crops.
sentences.zh: 农业被定义为在土地上种植作物。

sentences.en: He soiled his white shirt when he changed the ink cartridge.
sentences.zh: 他换墨盒的时候把白衬衫弄脏了。
